scope: Real local PostgreSQL 16, real Drizzle SQL and repositories. Neon HTTP transport replaced with a local psql adapter; external model/channel transports mocked.
checks: Widget settings persist through real PostgreSQL
PostgreSQL visitor session validates its hashed token and origin
Concurrent PostgreSQL rate cap admits exactly five requests
PostgreSQL sequence preserves accepted event order
FIFO gate rejects out-of-order claim in PostgreSQL
Concurrent PostgreSQL workers claim one event exactly once
PostgreSQL processor sends and records all three replies once
PostgreSQL processor debits exactly one token per response
Replaying completed PostgreSQL jobs never resends or recharges
Concurrent idempotent message inserts remain unique in PostgreSQL
Expired PostgreSQL generation requires review and operator takeover
